function.name: self_get_device_status
function.description: Get speaker volume, screen brightness, battery level, and Wi-Fi status. Call before changing volume if its current value is unknown.

function.name: self_audio_speaker_set_volume
function.description: Set speaker volume from 0 to 100. Call `self_get_device_status` first if the current volume is unknown.

function.name: self_camera_take_photo
function.description: Take a photo to answer a visual question. Pass the question in `question`.

function.name: self_robot_drive
function.description: Move forward, backward, left, or right, then stop after `duration_ms`. Cliff safety may block movement.

function.name: self_face_set_emotion
function.description: Show a temporary face emotion: neutral, happy, bored, laughing, funny, sad, angry, crying, loving, embarrassed, surprised, shocked, thinking, winking, cool, relaxed, delicious, kissy, confident, sleepy, silly, confused, suspicious, or shake.

function.name: self_face_look
function.description: Look temporarily: center, left, right, up, down, up_left, up_right, down_left, or down_right.

function.name: self_secondary_display_show_text
function.description: Show short UTF-8 text, including Vietnamese, on the secondary OLED; telemetry returns afterward.

function.name: self_status_light_set_effect
function.description: Temporarily set the status lights to steady, breathe, blink, or off. Motor indication has priority.

function.name: self_distance_get
function.description: Get downward floor distance and cliff-detection state.

function.name: self_environment_get
function.description: Get cached temperature, humidity, pressure, and illuminance with per-sensor validity.

function.name: self_battery_get_status
function.description: Get detailed battery charge, voltage, current, power, and SoC diagnostics.

function.name: self_motion_get_orientation
function.description: Get orientation, acceleration, rotation, gesture, and gyro-turn state.

function.name: self_robot_turn_relative
function.description: Turn by a gyro-measured angle: positive is right, negative is left. Requires calibrated MPU6050, idle motors, and a safe floor.
